claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'EOS 5D Mark II' and the full-frame sensor is standard for this model; 21.1MP is a known specification for this camera.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have a dead screen.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powered on with the screen displaying a live image or menu.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near end-of-life (over 20,000 shutter actuations).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a Canon shutter count tool or a video showing the camera taking a photo and the shutter count being displayed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter count, which reduces value significantly

risks.risk: The camera may have internal damage or missing components (e.g., battery, charger, strap).
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery, charger, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which reduces value

risks.risk: The camera may have water damage or internal corrosion.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the camera body, especially around the lens mount and buttons, showing no signs of moisture or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value

proof_requests: Photo of the camera powered on with the screen displaying a live image or menu.
Screenshot of the shutter count from a Canon shutter count tool.
Photo showing the battery, charger, and any included accessories.
Close-up photo of the camera body showing no signs of water damage or corrosion.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
